A separate pantry reference

Gluten-Free

A calm label guide for building bowls from the ingredients already at home. Product recipes and manufacturing practices vary, so check the package when strict gluten avoidance matters.

Naturally gluten-free ingredients

Grains + legumes

Quinoa, wild rice, corn grits, chickpeas, lentils and beans.

Nuts + seeds

Almond flour, coconut flour, walnuts, cashews, macadamia, sunflower, pumpkin, hemp, flax, chia and basil seeds.

Produce + fish

Fresh vegetables, fruit, herbs and plain fish are naturally gluten-free; seasoned or prepared products may contain additions.

Cross-contact: for strict avoidance, choose grains, legumes and seeds with a gluten-free label because growing, handling and processing can introduce cross-contact.

Read the label

Check the package on these pantry items; recipes and brands differ.

Condiments + sauces

Soy sauce, teriyaki, Worcestershire, moromi vinegar, mirin, curry paste, chili-garlic sauce and crunchy chili oil.

Default to coconut aminos or certified gluten-free tamari when a recipe calls for soy sauce.

Broths + mixes

Chicken broth, mushroom broth, seasoning blends and prepared sauces. Read ingredient and allergen statements.

One definite skip

Ordinary couscous is made from wheat semolina and is not gluten-free. See Beyond Celiac: couscous.

For gluten-free food labeling information, see the FDA gluten-free labeling Q&A.
